mobbin:75bb46c3-1130-4cba-b194-ba086320d.summary: On a meeting page, the user picks which sections the AI summary should include, taps 'Save & Apply', waits while it regenerates, then reads the notes, including an empty Blockers section.
steps: AI Summary: template list and Customize
Tailored Notes window: section list and descriptions
Window: Outline and Blockers checked; 'Save & Apply'
Regenerated notes: chapters and empty Blockers line
steal: A checklist of sections, each saying in plain words what the AI will pull out, shapes the report without a builder (screens 2 to 3).
'Save' keeps the preferences, and 'Save & Apply' also regenerates this meeting's summary straight away (screen 3).
A processing message while the transcript is analysed again is honest about the AI wait (screen 4).
An empty section says 'No blockers were explicitly discussed' instead of disappearing, so the absence is clear (screen 5).
avoid: Sales and meeting templates (BANT, Standup) in the same list are the wrong lens for clinical simulation; keep only debrief and competency templates (screen 1).
mobbin:75bb46c3-1130-4cba-b194-ba086320d.fit: Reports: an AI formative or summative report of a recorded session, with templates and section switches for debrief PDFs. It pairs with the transcript time stamps in the session video review screen (SRV), not with Performance Matrix.
